MERGE INTO ICOMCOD2 A USING ( SELECT 'WMST' AS TYPE ,CA.BUYER ,CA.BYIT_COMORG_CODE||CA.BUYER_ITEM_NO||CA.CONTRACT_NO||CA.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CODE ,'Y' AS FLAG ,CA.CART_QTY FROM ICOMCART CA, ICOMCQDT CQ, ICOMBYIT BT WHERE CA.BUYER = #{comCode} AND CA.USER_ID = #{userid}
AND CA.BUYER_ITEM_NO||CA.CONTRACT_NO||CA.CONTRACT_SEQ||CA.SEQ IN ( #{ITEM_ARRAY} )
AND CA.BUYER_ITEM_NO||CA.CONTRACT_NO||CA.CONTRACT_SEQ IN ( #{ITEM_ARRAY} )
AND CA.USE_FLAG = 'C' AND CA.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = BT.BUYER AND CA.BUYER_ITEM_NO = BT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND CQ.BUYER = BT.BUYER AND CQ.BUYER_ITEM_NO = BT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND CA.BUYER_ITEM_NO = CQ.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND CA.CONTRACT_NO = CQ.CONTRACT_NO AND CA.CONTRACT_SEQ = CQ.CONTRACT_SEQ AND BT.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N' AND BT.STATUS <> 'D' AND CQ.STATUS <> 'D' )B ON ( A.TYPE = B.TYPE AND A.COMPANY_CODE = B.BUYER AND A.CODE = B.CODE ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.VALUE1 = A.VALUE1 - B.CART_QTY
